memo: Decode-only validation, CPU (weekly GPU quota used up), no submit. dn1-1b (formula-constrained de novo generator, novel condition 0.5) generated the truth for 0.124 of 250 held-out NP molecules (MMP 0.053), but only 24.1% of samples were valid SMILES. dn1g reads dn1-1b's weights (kernel output dn1.pt) and adds grammar constraints to the sampler (ours): no ')' without an open '(', no empty or bond-only branches, a ring number closes only if open and never on the atom that opened it, EOS only when every parenthesis and ring is closed and every heavy atom is placed; samples with no legal token left end and are discarded. Same 250 molecules, 4 spectra x 48 samples. Pass: valid rate >= 0.5 and truth generated >= 0.15.
